comp-m7cdvofc3.html: About Us.

comp-m7cdvofd3.html:
At Owl Dental, we are dedicated to providing exceptional care through state-of-the-art facilities and a team of highly skilled professionals.

​

Formerly Redmond Square Dental, our practice has been a trusted part of the community for over 30 years. Now, as Owl Dental, we continue this legacy—delivering top-quality dental and oral healthcare to Wexford.

​

Our mission is simple: to offer outstanding care in a safe and welcoming environment for all patients, both new and returning. From root canals and Invisalign to extractions, we provide personalized treatments to address a wide range of dental needs. If specialized care is required, we offer referrals to trusted local experts—ensuring you receive the best treatment without the hassle of long-distance travel.

​

Book an appointment today and experience the difference in care for you and your family.
